## Design

### 2026-10-24 – After a VERY long session this afternoon, I am most of the way done with my project.

**8h**

After a VERY long session this afternoon, I am most of the way done with my project.

I started off by following the directions for the basic project, I I very quickly realized that I was going to want more than 7 keys on my keyboard, but there wasn't enough GPIO pins to add as many as I wanted. To fix this, I decided to use a MPR121 breakout board so I could connect up to 12 capacitive sensors using only 2 GPIO pins. This took me a while because I couldn't find any symbols or footprints for it online, so I had to make my own, which I had never done before.

I also decided to add more switches and use the button on the rotary encoder since this opened up more GPIO pins.

After this I started routing the traces on the board. Right when I had finished, my Kicad instance crashed. At this point I hadn't yet saved the project, and because of this I lost all my progress on the PCB design. However, the scematic was saved so I didn't have to start from scratch. Designing the footprints for the keys was tricky and took a while, but I'm pretty happy with the way they turned out.

After this, I worked on exporting and formatting the files to be uploaded to the GitHub. I also wrote the Github README and made the BOM for this project. All I have left to do now is to focus on the software.
